ownership_reason: readNextToken owns the fault. Its leading loop is documented (comment directly above it) to skip ignored/trimmed characters 'unless it is the field delimiter or the quote character', i.e. it must stop as soon as the delimiter matcher OR the quote matcher matches; the variant only stops when a character is both a delimiter and a quote. In the TSV prototype the tab delimiter is also matched by the trimmer (StrMatcher.trimMatcher matches every char <= 32), so after the token 'one' readNextToken consumes the second tab as whitespace and never reaches its own empty-token branch ('handle empty token'), so the empty middle field disappears. The competitors are correct and unchanged: addToken drops an empty token only when ignoreEmptyTokens is true, and the TSV prototype sets it to false; readWithQuotes ends a token at the first delimiter and returns the position just after it, and together with tokenize it yields empty tokens for consecutive delimiters whenever the delimiter is not also trimmable/ignorable, as the existing passing tests StrTokenizerTest::test7 (consecutive space delimiters give "", "") and StrTokenizerTest::test1 (';' with trailing empties) show. Restoring '||' in readNextToken alone makes the trigger pass with the full suite green; none of the declared one-line competitor edits does.
